name: Shopify Taxonomy Importer
tagline: Importing Shopify's Standard Product Taxonomy into Virto Commerce catalog

readme.overview: Shopify Taxonomy module introduces functionality for importing Shopify's Standard Product Taxonomy into Virto Commerce Catalog. It enhances the performance and quality of new catalogue configurations with open-source taxonomy and attributes.

notes.forAnalyst: Fills a new catalog with Shopify's Standard Product Taxonomy: its categories, product attributes, the allowed values for them and their translations. A catalog starts from a widely used classification instead of an empty tree.
notes.forArchitect: A one-time import into Catalog, its only dependency. It reads the taxonomy from the file at `ShopifyTaxonomy.ShopifyTaxonomyFileUrl`, Shopify's published distribution by default, in the languages listed in `ShopifyTaxonomy.ShopifyTaxonomyLanguagesCodes`. It keeps no tables; what it creates are ordinary catalog categories, properties and dictionary values, owned by Catalog from then on.
notes.forDeveloper: It is started from the catalog's Import menu in the back office. Shopify attributes become catalog properties and their values become dictionary values, which products then use like any other property.
reachForItWhen: Setting up a new catalog with no existing classification
Products that will also be listed on channels that use Shopify's taxonomy
doNotReachForItWhen: A catalog that already has its own category tree and properties. The import adds Shopify's structure; it does not map yours onto it
A specialist B2B assortment that a general retail taxonomy does not describe well
